text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Iraqi press on Saturday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Iraq decides to suspend military action against U.S. and allied warplanes
- More Arab and Islamic support for Iraq's military standoff with U.S.
- Russia and China oppose use of military force against Iraq
- Fleet of trucks ferries fuel to northern Iraq
- Turkey urges Washington to open dialogue with Iraq
- Yemeni parliament condemns U.S. missile attack on Iraq
(The above were also carried by QADISSIYA, JUMHOURIYA and AL-IRAQ)
- Editorial says Iraq hopes its decision to stop firing missiles at U.S. and allied warplanes will defuse military standoff with Washington.
- Editorial lambasts U.S. for hostile acts
- Commentary advises Clinton to leave Iraq alone
- Editorial says Iraq not threatening U.S. interests in region
- Primakov says his country is not a U.S. satellite and objects to use of force against Iraq
- Demonstrations in London and Hong Kong against U.S. missile strikes on Iraq
